verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's own library exposes a unified `completion()` interface for calling any provider, with responses normalized to the OpenAI Chat Completions format. Its proxy is a drop-in for OpenAI-compatible code, and a maintainer confirmed it supports streaming and function-calling the same way the openai-python SDK does. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond the Python library (other languages), dedicated SDK reference/installation docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.
